inputs.text:
Wake up. Everything you are being told about this latest public theater is a complete inversion of reality, orchestrated by the hidden elites pulling the strings behind the curtain. The owner of Blue Waters comes out with a controlled narrative, claiming that the Government collects taxes from them “without doing or investing in anything.” This is nothing more than a staged distraction by the architects of the system to manage public perception. 

Do not fall for their official cover story about environmental protection or green levies. When they try to spin it by saying, "Perhaps this might be considered as an environmental tax," that is the glaring red flag exposing their true agenda. They always manufacture a crisis—pushing the scripted line that "Plastic bottles can be found everywhere, blocking rivers and drains, which then enter..."—to justify a deeper level of extraction and control over commerce. The mess in the rivers is not an accident at all; it is managed chaos meticulously designed to condition the public into accepting more taxes and centralized oversight. They are playing a much bigger game, and the public is being kept completely in the dark.
